name: Swimming Pool
description: Fresh water pool and nererefill namin  for every guest.  Walang chemicals so safe for both human and pets.

name: River Access for Kayak
description: Sa right side po ng property ay meron ilog kung saan pwede po kayo mag kayak.  P500 lang po ang rental sa inflatable kayak.

name: Kitchen
description: Kumpleto po sa gamit ang kitchen natin sa pagluluto.  Meron lamang tayong P200 fee for LPG.  Microwave overn, electric kettle at griller ay free to use.  Meron na rin po plato at kutsara sa resort.

name: Shower  and CRs
description: Meron po tayong 2 shower areas and 1 cr.  Exclusive lang po ito sa inyo at wlang ibang gagamit.

name: Free Parking (unattended)
description: Sa parking po natin, kasya ang 1 sasakyan sa loob.  There are also spaces outside but park at your own risk.

name: Bonfire Pit
description:
Meron po tayo drum na pwede gamitin for bonfire and smores.  

Update: pinagbabawal na po ng LGU ng San Felipe ang pag gawa ng bon fire.

name: WiFi
description: Meron po tayong free wifi.  Ito po ay powered by Converge Fiber Internet.  300Mbps speed na enough for freelancer, work from home and digital nomad.
